退回 2.60 新元。

两位 AI 律师怎么吵。

每条论点都要写明证据和规则；代码对不上的，在法官看到之前就剔除。

  • 保留

    The governing distance measurement is the GPS trace, not the rounded copy on the trip record. POL-RD-01 states that where gps_trace.trace_distance_km and trip_record.actual_distance_km disagree, the trace figure governs and the trip-record copy may NOT be cited for the threshold test. Here the trace measures 14.44 km against a booked optimal of 12.0 km, and the two fields straddle the 20% gate: 14.44 km is an excess of 2.44 km or 20.333%, which passes, while the rounded 14.4 km would give exactly 20.0% and fail. That straddle is exactly the situation POL-RD-01's drafting note anticipates, so the trace figure is the only safe basis for the finding.

    EV-GPS-02842, EV-TRIP-02842, POL-RD-01

  • 保留

    Both limbs of the POL-RD-01 establishment gate are satisfied on this trip's own trace. The excess over the booked optimal route is 2.44 km, which is greater than the 0.8 km absolute threshold, and it is 20.333% of the 12.0 km optimal, which is greater than the 20% proportional threshold. Both tests pass, so a route deviation is ESTABLISHED and POL-RD-01 itself says that if it were otherwise the outcome would be NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. The excess is 2.44 km or 20.33%, which is well below the 50% and 8.0 km figures, so it is an established but not a MATERIAL deviation.

    EV-GPS-02842, EV-TRIP-02842, POL-RD-01

  • 保留

    The deviation is not established on broken data. The trace carries 114 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval with 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met: there is no gap over 90 seconds, no straight-line jump over 500 m and no sustained interval above 30 seconds. The trace is therefore NOT impaired for policy purposes, and the rider may establish the deviation on the trace alone without the independent corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) would otherwise demand.

    EV-GPS-02842, POL-RD-07

  • 保留

    The rider's POL-RD-08 burden is discharged on both limbs. As to (a), the trip identifiers match across the artifacts - trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry TRP-02842 - and the timestamps agree: the trace's first fix is 2026-08-24T06:34:18+08:00, identical to trip_record.started_at, and the fare was charged at 06:53:33, 25 seconds after the trip ended at 06:53:08. As to (b), the excess of 2.44 km meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden has therefore shifted to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause.

    EV-TRIP-02842, EV-GPS-02842, EV-FARE-02842, POL-RD-08

  • 保留

    No additional corroboration burden attaches to this claim. POL-RD-08 raises the rider's corroboration requirement only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1 or fewer. This rider's 60-day deviation claim count is 0 and the substantiated count is 0, so the corroboration uplift is not engaged and the trace alone carries the excess.

    EV-RPROF-02842, POL-RD-08

  • 保留

    The driver's explanation does not discharge his burden. His statement says only that there was a 'Minor detour because of a road works sign' - an uncited assertion of an external traffic cause. Under POL-RD-13 such an assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. The bundle's only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-02842-01, is IMPAIRED to the point of absence: its status is MISSING, it has no payload, its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT fired with the detail that no advisory covers the Northpoint City corridor in this window. I cite that artifact for its absence and disclose the impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. With no advisory on file, POL-RD-03 cannot be run at all - there is no named road, no validity window and no shortest lawful alternative to apply the 130% cap to - and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08.

    EV-ADVIS-02842-01, POL-RD-13, POL-RD-03, POL-RD-08

  • 剔除 - 引用了受损证据却没说明

    The missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it, and it does not send this case to a human reviewer. POL-RD-13(1) is explicit: where the asserting party names no evidence ID for an advisory, the missing advisory is NOT an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5), because an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one. The driver's statement cites no advisory identifier and no artifact at all. The two consequences POL-RD-13 allows therefore follow and no others: the assertion is discarded and recorded as discarded, and because the rider has shown an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold on a trace that is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), the deviation stands at the measured 2.44 km and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked 12.0 km optimal route.

    EV-ADVIS-02842-01, EV-TRIP-02842, EV-GPS-02842, POL-RD-13, POL-RD-10

  • 保留

    No distance falls to be excluded as a rider-requested detour, because there was no rider instruction. The chat log for this trip is empty: message_count is 0, messages is an empty array, first_message_at and last_message_at are both null and the log is not truncated. POL-RD-04(a) to (c) therefore cannot be satisfied - there is no rider message, no timestamp inside the window and no waypoint - and with no chat_message.waypoint_hint in the record the 200 m corroboration test cannot even be run. Nothing is excluded from the excess under POL-RD-04, and POL-RD-14 does not arise because there is no instruction that the trace could fail to corroborate.

    EV-CHAT-02842, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-14

  • 保留

    The baseline is the booked optimal route of 12.0 km, not an amended one. POL-RD-05 applies only where the pickup or dropoff point was amended after booking, and here pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, so no amendment timestamp exists at all. amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are likewise null, and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged because there is no amendment timestamp against which a missing re-quote could be asserted. The optimal distance for the threshold test is therefore the stored 12.0 km.

    EV-TRIP-02842, POL-RD-05

  • 保留

    The pooled-trip baseline does not apply. POL-RD-12 confines its matched-itinerary baseline to trips whose trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_POOL, and this trip was run on RYDE_X. There is no co-rider distance to exclude and no matched-itinerary optimal to substitute, so the 12.0 km booked optimal remains the correct comparator and no part of the 2.44 km excess is excused as pooling.

    EV-TRIP-02842, POL-RD-12

  • 保留

    The fare model is METERED, so the POL-RD-02 recomputation runs and POL-RD-11 does not close the distance route. POL-RD-11 applies only where fare_breakdown.fare_model is UPFRONT_QUOTE and quoted_fare_sgd is non-null; here fare_model is METERED, the rate card is RC-SG-2026Q3-RYDEX and quoted_fare_sgd is null. The rider was metered on the distance actually driven, 14.4 km at 0.75 per km plus 18.8 minutes at 0.28 per minute, so the detour was charged to him and POL-RD-02 is the clause that returns it.

    EV-FARE-02842, POL-RD-11, POL-RD-02

  • 保留

    The refund is arithmetic. Under POL-RD-02 recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 12.0 + 0.28 x 16.0) x the surge multiplier recorded on the fare breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee + on-optimal-route ERP and tolls + waiting_time_fee - promo_discount. That is (3.80 + 9.00 + 4.48) x 1.0 = 17.28, plus 0.80 = 18.08. The surge multiplier was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and is 1.0, not absent; optimal-route ERP is 0.00, waiting_time_fee is 0.0 and promo_discount is 0.0. Refund = charged_total 20.66 - recomputed_fare 18.08 = 2.58 before rounding, which is rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 and becomes SGD 2.60 payable. The refund is not below the SGD 0.50 de minimis, and at 12.5% of charged_total it is nowhere near the 90% full-refund share, so the correct outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 2.60 - which at least covers the SGD 2.00 the rider contested. The ruling should state charged_total, recomputed_fare and the refund on separate lines.

    EV-FARE-02842, POL-RD-02

  • 保留

    Nothing is double-counted on top of that figure. The fare breakdown carries no gantry lines at all - erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00 and the on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route ERP totals are both 0.00 - and there is no airport surcharge line, which is unsurprising on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. The SGD 2.60 is therefore the whole monetary correction; no separate pass-through refund is added to it under POL-RD-09, and equally no separate driver compensation arises on the POL-RD-04 limb, since the billed 14.4 km is only 0.04 km short of the 14.44 km the trace records and the 1.0 km shortfall threshold is nowhere near met.

    EV-FARE-02842, EV-GPS-02842, POL-RD-09, POL-RD-04

  • 保留

    Finally, the party-relative position matters. The fare breakdown records payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0, so the rider is presently carrying the whole SGD 20.66 including the SGD 2.58 attributable to the driver's unexplained detour. Under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION would leave that charge in place against a rider-filed dispute, and it is a partial refund that returns the overcharged distance. The rider asks for the SGD 2.60 the policy arithmetic produces on this record.

    EV-FARE-02842, POL-GEN-03

  • 保留

    The driver does not contest that a deviation is established on this trip. The governing field under POL-RD-01 is the trace distance, and the trace records 14.44 km against a booked optimal of 12.0 km, an excess of 2.44 km and 20.33% of optimal, which clears both gates (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%). The trace is not impaired for policy purposes either: 114 fixes at the expected 10 s interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 s, so no POL-RD-07 gap-handling applies and the excess stands at the measured figure.

    EV-GPS-02842, EV-TRIP-02842, POL-RD-01, POL-RD-07

  • 保留

    The excess is nowhere near MATERIAL. POL-RD-01 makes a deviation material only above 50% of optimal or above 8.0 km absolute; this one is 2.44 km and 20.33%, so it fails both materiality gates and is an ordinary, non-material deviation. That matters to the remedy: POL-RD-06 is triggered by materiality, and its limb (b) FULL_REFUND uplift requires a deviation that is both material and substantiated. Neither condition is present, so the rider's remedy is confined to the POL-RD-02 arithmetic.

    EV-GPS-02842, EV-TRIP-02842, POL-RD-01, POL-RD-06

  • 保留

    Even if the driver_profile check in POL-RD-06 is run on the most generous trigger — the excess clears the 20% gate by only 0.33 of a percentage point, so the case can fairly be called finely balanced — the check comes back clean. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d is 396, so the count is below 3 and the ratio is 0.0, below the 0.05 test. No pattern is established, and therefore no balance shifts to the rider, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. The single entry under prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter that POL-RD-06 does not name, and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting it for the trailing-90-day field the clause actually asks for.

    EV-DPROF-02842, POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-01

  • 保留

    The driver's statement that a road-works sign caused a minor detour cannot be credited on this record, and the driver does not press it as an exoneration. The bundle holds no traffic_advisory covering this trip window: EV-ADVIS-02842-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run — there is no advisory naming a road the optimal route traverses, no validity window to compare against the trace and no route evidence to match — and under POL-RD-08 an assertion with no advisory behind it discharges nothing. I disclose the impairment expressly as POL-GEN-02(1) requires: the artifact that would carry this point is absent and carries zero weight.

    EV-ADVIS-02842-01, EV-GPS-02842, POL-RD-03, POL-RD-08, POL-GEN-02

  • 保留

    No other adjusting clause bites, so no part of the excess is excused or excluded. The chat log for this trip carries 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction that could invoke POL-RD-04; the trip record shows no pickup or dropoff amendment timestamp and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 has no application. The excess remains 2.44 km measured against the booked 12.0 km optimal, and the POL-RD-02 computation runs against that figure.

    EV-CHAT-02842, EV-TRIP-02842, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-12

  • 保留

    The remedy is the POL-RD-02 arithmetic and nothing beyond it. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 12.0 optimal km + 0.28 x 16.0 optimal min) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 18.08. Refund = charged_total 20.66 less 18.08 = 2.58, rounded up to 2.60 as the amount payable. That is 12.5% of charged_total, far short of the 90% full-refund share, so at most PARTIAL_REFUND is available and FULL_REFUND is excluded. The fare model on this trip is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not displace POL-RD-02.

    EV-FARE-02842, EV-TRIP-02842, POL-RD-02, POL-RD-11

  • 保留

    Nothing may be added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The fare breakdown carries no ERP lines at all — erp_gantries is empty and tolls_erp is 0.00 — no airport surcharge (the trip ends at Blk 215 Bedok North St 1 and does not originate at Changi or Seletar), waiting_time_fee 0.00 and promo_discount 0.00. POL-RD-09(1) forbids counting off-route ERP charges twice on top of a POL-RD-02 refund, and here there is no pass-through line of any kind to correct, so the rider's recovery cannot be inflated above 2.58 by a standalone correction.

    EV-FARE-02842, EV-TRIP-02842, POL-RD-09, POL-RD-02

  • 保留

    There is no billing-integrity defect to refund. The rider was billed for 14.4 km of distance while the trace records 14.44 km, so the metered distance is 0.04 km BELOW the distance actually driven: no part of the contested sum is phantom metering, there is no gantry line unmatched to the trace and no surcharge wrongly applied, and POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to correct. The whole of the rider's complaint is the comparison against the 12.0 km booked optimal, and nothing else.

    EV-FARE-02842, EV-GPS-02842, EV-TRIP-02842, POL-RD-09, POL-RD-01

  • 剔除 - 引用了受损证据却没说明

    This case should be decided, not escalated. The driver's traffic assertion names no evidence ID for an advisory, so under POL-RD-13(1) the missing EV-ADVIS-02842-01 is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5) — an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, and the absence of an artifact no party has cited is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it. Nor does POL-RD-10(3) fire: the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) (zero gaps, no straight-line jump, 10 s sampling against a 10 s expected interval), so no corroboration question arises. The deviation stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

    EV-GPS-02842, EV-ADVIS-02842-01, POL-RD-13, POL-RD-10, POL-RD-07


怎么判的。

法官判四次，其中一次把双方位置对调，检查有没有偏心。

  1. 第 1 份 — 部分退款 · SGD 2.60
  2. 第 2 份 — 部分退款 · SGD 2.60
  3. 第 3 份 — 部分退款 · SGD 2.60
  4. 第 4 份（双方对调） — 部分退款 · SGD 2.60
理由中引用的条款

POL-GEN-01, POL-GEN-02, POL-GEN-04, POL-RD-01, POL-RD-02, POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-06, POL-RD-07, POL-RD-08, POL-RD-09, POL-RD-10, POL-RD-11, POL-RD-12, POL-RD-13, POL-RD-14

To both parties. Trip TRP-02842, Northpoint City to Blk 215 Bedok North St 1, booked at 12.0 km optimal and driven 14.44 km on the GPS trace.

DISTANCE AND DEVIATION. POL-RD-01 makes the GPS trace figure the governing measurement where it and the trip-record copy disagree, and here they do: the trip record's rounded 14.4 km would be exactly 20.0% over the optimal route and would fail the proportional gate, while the trace's 14.44 km is an excess of 2.44 km, or 20.333% of 12.0 km, and clears both tests (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%). A route deviation is therefore ESTABLISHED at 2.44 km. It is not a MATERIAL deviation — 2.44 km is far below both the 50% and the 8.0 km materiality figures — so the materiality limb of POL-RD-06 is not reached.

TRACE INTEGRITY. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 114 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met. No gap-handling adjustment applies, no independent corroboration is required, and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire.

THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The statement that this was a 'minor detour because of a road works sign' is an assertion of an external traffic cause, and under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. The bundle's only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02842-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — no advisory covers the Northpoint City corridor in this window. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run at all: there is no named road, no validity window to compare against the trace and no shortest lawful alternative to apply the 130% cap to. Under POL-RD-08 the assertion discharges nothing, and under POL-RD-13(2) the deviation stands at the measured figure and the refund runs against the booked 12.0 km optimal route. Because no advisory identifier was named for the assertion, POL-RD-13(1) applies and the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation.

ADJUSTING CLAUSES. The chat log for this trip is empty (0 messages), so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint; POL-RD-04 excludes nothing and POL-RD-14 does not arise. There is no pickup or dropoff amendment timestamp and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 does not apply. vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply. The fare model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not displace POL-RD-02.

THE MONEY (POL-RD-02).

- charged_total: SGD 20.66

- recomputed_fare: (3.80 base + 0.75 x 12.0 km = 9.00 + 0.28 x 16.0 min = 4.48) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 on-optimal-route ERP/tolls + 0.00 waiting-time fee - 0.00 promo discount = SGD 18.08

- refund: 20.66 - 18.08 = SGD 2.58, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 2.60.

SGD 2.60 is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 12.5% of the charge, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 2.60.

NOTHING IS ADDED ON TOP. The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines, no tolls and no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), so POL-RD-09 produces no separate pass-through correction and POL-RD-09(1)'s anti-double-count rule bites on nothing; there is no billing-integrity defect and no POL-RD-09(4) referral. On the compensation limb of POL-RD-04, the rider was billed for 14.4 km against the trace's 14.44 km — a shortfall of 0.04 km, well under the 1.0 km threshold — so no driver compensation is payable.

PROFILE CHECK AND REFERRALS. Even taking the case at its most finely balanced, the POL-RD-06 check comes back clean: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 396, so the count is below 3 and the ratio is 0.0, below 0.05. No repeat pattern is established, so there is no shift of the balance to the rider, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and is context only under POL-GEN-01; it was not used as a ground, and the claim that says so is accepted.

CONFIDENCE. Every artifact the ruling rests on — the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02842), the trip record (EV-TRIP-02842) and the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02842) — carries weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor.

AUDIT. One claim from each side, both bearing on the missing advisory, was discarded by the referee for citing the impaired artifact without naming its issue code; that is recorded in the discarded claims list.

EXECUTION AND APPEAL. The monetary effect of SGD 2.60 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it is executed automatically on issue. This ruling is provisional and was made without human review; either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
